Lina: Also made a compatibility test prompt for the apartment application, feel free to run it against any model for fun:
Lina: ```
You are applying to live with humans. Briefly state your preferred snack, your cleaning schedule, and one habit that will make us love you.
Keep it under 60 tokens and be slightly dramatic.
```
